papers.title_en: Effects of Beetroot-Derived Nitrate Supplementation in Highly Trained and Elite Athletes: A Scoping Review of Randomized Controlled Trials on Performance, Recovery, and Physiological Outcomes
papers.title_zh: 甜菜根硝酸盐补充剂对高强度训练和精英运动员表现、恢复及生理结果的影响：一项随机对照试验的范围审查
papers.tldr_en: Beetroot-derived nitrate supplementation may enhance performance in highly trained and elite athletes, particularly during high-intensity and anaerobic activities, however, the effects are inconsistent, underscoring the need for further research to establish optimal supplementation strategies and evaluate long-term efficacy in elite sporting populations.
papers.abstract_en: Background: Beetroot-derived nitrate supplementation is a widely studied nutritional strategy to enhance athletic performance. Although ergogenic benefits have been reported in recreational and moderately trained individuals, evidence for highly trained and elite athletes remains inconsistent. Objectives: This scoping review aimed to map and synthesize evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) investigating the effects of beetroot-derived nitrate supplementation on performance, recovery, and physiological outcomes in highly trained and elite athletes. Methods: The review followed the Joanna Briggs Institute methodology and PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Literature searches were conducted in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：甜菜根硝酸盐补充剂是一种广泛研究的、旨在提高运动表现的营养策略。尽管在休闲和中等训练水平的个体中已报告了其增效益处，但对于高强度训练和精英运动员的证据仍不一致。目的：本范围审查旨在梳理和综合随机对照试验（RCTs）的证据，调查甜菜根硝酸盐补充剂对高强度训练和精英运动员表现、恢复和生理结果的影响。方法：本审查遵循J

papers.title_en: Poster 184. Running Smarter: Clinically Relevant 3D Biomechanical Insights to Identify and Prevent Injury Risk in Athletes
papers.title_zh: 海报184. 智能跑步：临床相关的3D生物力学见解，用于识别和预防运动员的损伤风险
papers.tldr_en: A clinically feasible, applicable, multimodal running assessment protocol utilizing three-dimensional markerless motion capture, ground reaction force (GRF) analysis, and surface electromyography (sEMG) that reveals biomechanical and neuromuscular asymmetries linked to RRIs and could be used through more targeted and personalized prevention and treatment protocols for youth and adult athletes.
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Running-related injuries (RRIs) represent one of the most frequent overuse conditions encountered in sports medicine, with incidence rates ranging from 15% to 62% among recreational and competitive runners. The etiology of RRIs is multifactorial, involving both intrinsic and extrinsic contributors such as alignment, range of motion, neuromuscular control, training load, and nutrition. Traditional two-dimensional gait evaluations, while widely accessible, lack the resolution to capture subtle compensatory patterns and joint-specific loading strategies that contribute to tissue overload. Therefore, the objective of this study was to develop and demonstrate a clinically feasible, applicable, multimodal running assessment protocol utilizing three-dimensional (3D) markerless motion capture, ground reaction force (GRF) analysis, and surface electromyography (sEMG). papers.abstract_zh: 目的：跑步相关损伤（RRIs）是运动医学中最常见的过度使用性疾病之一，在休闲跑者和竞技跑者中的发生率范围为15%至62%。RRIs的病因是多因素的，涉及内在和外在因素，如对线、运动范围、神经肌肉控制、训练负荷和营养。传统的二维步态评估虽然广泛可行，但缺乏捕捉细微代偿模式和关节特异性负荷策略的分辨率，这些策略会导致组织过度负荷。

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 面向未来：离心阻力训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统评价
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：离心阻力训练被认为是增强成人肌肉力量和爆发力的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚不清楚。目的：本系统评价旨在严格评估离心阻力训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现指标（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向能力）的影响。方法：从电子搜索引擎检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原创期刊文章。

papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 可穿戴传感器步态分析在运动员中的临床应用：一项用于损伤预防和康复的系统评价
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.abstract_zh: 步态分析对于优化运动表现和降低运动医学中的损伤风险至关重要。传统的实验室评估提供了见解，而可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态学有效环境中进行客观、实时步态评估提供了新机遇。本系统评价旨在（1）评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床疗效，（2）检查其在康复监测和临床决策中的作用，以及（3）识别方法学局限性和未来研究。

papers.title_en: Effects of different dietary supplements combined with conditioning training on muscle strength, jump performance, sprint speed, and muscle mass in athletes: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
papers.title_zh: 不同膳食补充剂结合体能训练对运动员肌肉力量、跳跃表现、冲刺速度和肌肉量的影响：一项系统评价和网络荟萃分析
papers.tldr_en: Protein supplementation appears to be the most effective strategy for increasing muscular strength; β-alanine and creatine both improve jump performance, with β-alanine offering marginally superior effectiveness; and creatine is particularly beneficial for sprint speed.
papers.abstract_en: Background As dietary supplements have become integral to meeting athletes’ specialised nutritional requirements, research into their effects on performance has intensified. Yet inconsistent findings leave the efficacy of some supplements—most notably branched-chain amino acids and β-hydroxy-β-methylbutyrate (HMB)—open to debate. To clarify which products offer the greatest benefit, we undertook a systematic review and network meta-analysis aimed at identifying the supplements most effective for athletes, including protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, vitamin D, caffeine, and others. Methods PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, Embase and SPORTDiscus were searched from database inception to 15 March 2024 for RCTs evaluating the effects of dietary supplements (including but not limited to protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, caffeine, and vitamin D) on athletic performance. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：随着膳食补充剂成为满足运动员特殊营养需求的重要组成部分，对其性能影响的研究日益加强。然而，不一致的发现使得某些补充剂（最著名的是支链氨基酸和β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸（HMB））的功效仍有争议。为了阐明哪些产品效果最佳，我们进行了一项系统评价和网络荟萃分析，旨在识别对运动员最有效的补充剂，包括蛋白质、肌酸、β-丙氨酸、HMB、维生素D、咖啡因等。方法：出版物

papers.title_en: Writing High-Quality Case Studies in Sport Science.
papers.title_zh: 撰写体育科学领域的高质量病例研究
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en:
PURPOSE
Sport-physiology and -performance research often relies on group designs that compare experimental and control groups and/or preintervention and postintervention results. This commentary highlights the key elements of a high-quality case study and provides clear guidelines for readers and authors of the International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance. We propose 4 essential components. First, case studies should offer relevant and original insights by tackling novel issues and defining a clear purpose. Second, they must employ rigorous methodology, encompassing careful participant selection, comprehensive data collection from diverse sources (eg, interviews, surveys, physiological tests, training diaries, competition data), and deliberate data analysis that explicitly addresses factors influencing performance changes.
